body.message: Hello Vijay, Thank you for sharing the bank details. However, as the booking is under the name of Antoine Cornet and the bank details provided are under a different name, we will need written confirmation from Mr. Antoine Cornet confirming that the shared bank details are correct and approved for processing. Once we receive the confirmation, we can proceed with the deposit refund. Thank you, and we look forward to your response. Kind regards, Chahana T.
